claim: A negative control for an interrupt-timed fault must sweep where the interrupt lands (the start line over a frame); one phase per state can miss the broken build.

evidence.text: the no-repair control passed on 6 states at their own start line and was caught once the start line swept the frame every 13 lines
evidence.quote: the push-repair control was missed on 6 states

next_check: Count how many of the swept phases catch each control.
